10k.note: FY2025 10-K. Lead asset PF614 with TAAP platform; PF614-MPAR adds MPAR overdose protection.

website.note: Corporate site landing pages mostly framework HTML; substantive pipeline content sourced from press releases (PF614-301 Phase 3 first patient enrolled Dec 2025; PF614-MPAR-102 Part 2 fully enrolled). Direct pipeline page returned no parseable asset content.

ctgov.note: 9 trials returned; 7 COMPLETED (mostly Phase 1). 2 RECRUITING: NCT06602271 (PF614-301 Phase 3 acute postoperative pain) and NCT06500793 (PF614-MPAR-102 Phase 1 PK with nafamostat).

pipeline.modality: Trypsin-Activated Abuse Protection (TAAP) extended-release oxycodone prodrug; oral capsule
pipeline.target: Mu-opioid receptor (oxycodone payload released by trypsin in GI tract)

indications.trial_name: PF614-301 (pivotal Phase 3 in acute postoperative pain)
indications.trial_design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 in post-abdominoplasty pain (3 US sites)
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (start 2025-12-09; primary completion 2026-08); first patient dosed Dec 2025

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 experimental pain model evaluating PF614 vs placebo/control

pipeline.modality: Co-formulated PF614 (TAAP oxycodone prodrug) with nafamostat (trypsin inhibitor) - Multi-Pill Abuse Resistance (MPAR) overdose-protection technology
pipeline.target: Mu-opioid receptor (with overdose 'switch-off' via trypsin inhibition)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (NIDA grant supports through May 2027); FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation

indications.indication: Severe pain requiring opioid analgesia with overdose protection (PK characterization)
indications.trial_design: Single-dose PK study in healthy volunteers (Quotient Sciences)
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (start 2024-11-24; Part 2 fully enrolled per Apr 2026 update)
